articles.summary: The “Give Yourself the Freedom to” campaign invites people with diabetes around the world to show themselves compassion and self-care. Global survey data shows approximately 6 in 10 people with type 1 and type 2 diabetes want more holistic support, including mental health resources. Insulet is also supporting various diabetes community and colleague engagement initiatives around the globe. In recognition of World Diabetes Day on November 14, 2026, Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD) (Insulet or the Company), the global leader in tubeless insulin pump technology with its Omnipod ® brand of products, today announced its “Give Yourself the Freedom to” campaign designed to raise awareness of the often overlooked emotional and mental demands of living with diabetes and encourage people living with diabetes to prioritize their own well-being. “Living with diabetes extends far beyond managing glucose levels and making treatment decisions. articles.summary: Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), the global leader in tubeless insulin pump technology with its Omnipod ® brand of products, today announced that management will present at the 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 10:30 a.m. (GMT). The live webcast and replay of the presentation will be accessible on the Insulet Investor Relations website: investors.insulet.com/events . About Insulet Corporation: Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle.
